headline: Discovered core protocol addresses and audit links; multi-chain cataloguing incomplete due to 30+ chain scope
short_headline: Discovery in progress; core addresses identified

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Midas RWA' surfaced 4 addresses on Ethereum: 0xa0819ae43115420beb161193b8d8ba64c9f9facc (Old Deployer/EOA), 0x5a42864b14C0C8241EF5ab62Dae975b163a2E0C1 (mHyperETH proxy), 0x97e6e31afb2d93d437301e006d9da714616766a5 (MIDAS token), 0xe9ce9ff1891e1f38778fceefc53350ea3a7370d7 (RWA contract)
Docs site at docs.midas.app references 'Smart Contracts Addresses' page, but direct fetch failed; deployed_contracts_doc URL identified but not yet traversable

Sherlock audit linked at protocol.audit_links; May 2024 audit (sherlock-audit/2024-05-midas) references DepositVault, RedemptionVault, mTBILL, MidasAccessControl, and WithMidasAccessControl contracts with upgradeable patterns

Protocol spans 30 chains per DeFiLlama (Ethereum, Monad, Arbitrum, Plasma, Solana, BSC, Base, Katana, Hyperliquid L1, Etherlink, Flare, Plume, Rootstock, OP, Linea, Sonic, Unichain, Celo, TAC, Avalanche, Mantle, Ink, Sei, Berachain, 0G, Polygon, Bitcoin, Scroll, XRPL EVM, Sapphire, Sui). Per-chain enumeration via block explorer search not yet completed.
All addresses recorded in admin_addresses[] are traced to fetched Etherscan pages or search results with full URLs

rationale.verdict: Discovery is incomplete. Capability probe succeeded (web_fetch + web_search available). Core protocol contracts identified on Ethereum via Etherscan and audit references, but systematic per-chain exploration is required per D5. The 30-chain scope and null address_book necessitate broader search per D1–D5. Sherlock audit confirms upgradeable contract patterns but does not enumerate all deployed addresses per chain. Next run should prioritize block-explorer searches for each chain and attempt GitHub deployment artifacts if repo access becomes available.

evidence.shows: Midas RWA: Old Deployer EOA on Ethereum; deployed multiple mToken contracts; holds various Midas token balances (mBASIS, mMEV, USDT, etc.). Tagged as 'Contract Deployer'.
Midas: mHyperETH Token; ERC-20 proxy contract on Ethereum; admin role present per constructor signature showing proxy pattern (logic, admin_, data parameters)
Midas (MIDAS) token on Ethereum; ERC-20 with RBAC; MidasToken contract with MINTER_ROLE and BURNER_ROLE permission controls; max supply 5M MIDAS
RWA contract on Ethereum; references Uniswap factory (0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f) and router (0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D); token swap logic
Midas Basis Trading Token (mBASIS) on Ethereum; ERC-20 token held by deployer and referenced in token holdings
Midas MEV (mMEV) token on Ethereum; ERC-20 token held by deployer; Midas product token

Sherlock audit repo for Midas RWA; May 2024 audit; contracts scoped: RedemptionVault, DepositVault, mTBILL, MidasAccessControl, WithMidasAccessControl, ManageableVault, Pausable, Greenlistable, and Blacklistable; reveals upgradeable proxy architecture
Midas RWA categorized as RWA; $206.13M TVL across 31 chains as of DeFiLlama snapshot; TVL breakdown shows Ethereum $140.11M, Monad $31.92M, Arbitrum $16.69M; confirms multi-chain deployment scope

Midas documentation confirms platform for composable onchain investment products; mTokens track underlying reference portfolios managed by strategy managers (BlackRock, Hyperithm, Edge Capital); NAV-based valuation

protocol_metadata.about: Midas is a platform for composable onchain investment products. It enables strategy managers to tokenize institutional investment strategies into mTokens that offer full transparency, instant redemptions, and DeFi composability. mTokens track underlying reference portfolios managed by appointed strategy managers such as BlackRock and Hyperithm, with valuations expressed as Net Asset Value (NAV) that fluctuates with underlying portfolio performance. The protocol is deployed across 30+ blockchain networks.
